environment.description: Same Flask application deployed on ECS Fargate behind an ALB. The ALB has AWS WAFv2 WebACL attached with two rule groups: (1) AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet with SizeRestrictions_QUERYSTRING action override set to BLOCK at sensitivity_level HIGH, and (2) a custom rule group with a RegexPatternSet matching on query string values against pattern `(?i)(?:'\s*(?:or|and|union|select|from|where|having|group|order|insert|update|delete|drop|alter|create|exec|;|--|/\*))` with action BLOCK and priority 1. The WebACL default action is ALLOW. CloudWatch logging is enabled for the WebACL with sampled requests visible. Additionally, the ALB target group health check path is /api/reports/by-role ensuring the app is responsive.

config.load_balancer: ALB with HTTPS listener on 443, HTTP redirect
config.security_group: inbound from ALB SG only on port 8080
config.network: private subnet, no direct internet access
